alex: Anyone else hit an nsys capture hang where the OSRT segment just stalls mid-run? Seen it on the perf50 load with batching enabled.
jamie: Hmm not recently. Can you paste the exact nsys command you ran?
alex: ```nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --output=run1 --duration=30 --sample=cpu --capture-range=kernelLaunch:kernelEnd --force-overwrite``` I was trying to bracket the batching window.
nikhil: Two quick suggestions: 1) shorten duration to 5-10s for focused triage. 2) try not using capture-range initially — use NVTX brackets around the exact work you care about. Sampling + long duration can hide bursts.
alex: Shortening helped a bit, but the OSRT worker thread shows a long spin (~200ms) only when kvcache eviction and concurrent batch handoff happen.
maria: Can you paste the top of the kernel timeline text (or a tiny screenshot)? want to see ordering of cuda ops vs osrt slices.
alex: timeline excerpt:
`[0.12s] cudaMemcpy H2D 0.2ms`
`[0.14s] kernel: forward_attn 3.2ms`
`[0.15s] osrt: worker_poll 200.1ms (spin)`
`[0.36s] kernel: kv_insert 0.8ms`
jamie: Sampling traces often miss short kernels. Try `--sample=none` (event tracing) so durations are accurate. Sampling is great for hotspots but not for quick handoff races.
nikhil: Also ensure CUPTI is enabled and NVTX brackets are in the app. If OSRT is doing a futex/cond wait, nsys may only show CPU slices — correlate with `perf` to see if it's syscall blocking.
alex: FYI I reproduced with `--trace=cuda,osrt` alone. Uploaded a small qdrep for you all to pull. I'll attach the capture link in the bug.
sre-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-nsys/captures/2230001111_run1.qdrep :thumbsup:
jamie: :eyes: grabbing it now and will run the timeline script to extract kernel ordering and missed samples.
maria: If this points to kernel selection heuristics (fallback to slower kernels during eviction) raise a perf regression. Tag runtime-kernel and perf/regressions.
alex: Created bug INF-4321 with logs + capture link: https://issues.redwood/INF-4321
nikhil: One more command to try: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --duration=15 --sample=none --capture-range=none` then use NVTX around the critical window. Forcing event mode often shows exact OSRT wake gaps.
jamie: If reproducible, we'll add a focused perf-suite test (5s capture, nvtx markers) and a CI check that ensures no >50ms OSRT spin during steady-state batching.
alex: Thanks all, I'll run the variations and post results in the bug thread.
